quests.title: The Arrival
quests.summary: A mysterious guide welcomes you to the fading Starlight Vale.

quests.title: First Sprout
quests.summary: Clear 3 overgrown plots and plant 5 Starlight Berries.

quests.title: Soil Secrets
quests.summary: Zyx teaches soil health: plant Cosmic Clover on a tired plot and watch it recover.

quests.title: Green Thumb
quests.summary: Prove the Vale can still provide: harvest 10 crops of any kind.

quests.title: Market Day
quests.summary: Pebble's ship is docked at the Alien Market. Sell him 5 crops to open trade.

quests.title: The Moonlit Pond
quests.summary: Restore the dried-up pond to bring water — and fishing — back to the Vale.

quests.title: First Catch
quests.summary: Juniper's stew needs fish. Catch 3 from the restored pond.

quests.title: Coop Raising
quests.summary: Mira has a spare coop. Buy your first Star Chicken to move in.

quests.title: The Egg Basket
quests.summary: Collect 5 glowing eggs for Mira's famous starlight quiche.

quests.title: Night Shift
quests.summary: Orbit insists the Vale is different after dark. Harvest 5 Starlight Berries at night.

quests.title: A Companion
quests.summary: Reach 25% Vale restoration — a bioluminescent fox has been watching you work.

quests.title: Pollinator Pals
quests.summary: Thistle grumbles that nothing sets fruit anymore. Install a Comet Bee hive.

quests.title: Glass and Vines
quests.summary: Repair the broken greenhouse so Lumina can begin her research.

quests.title: The Vale Blooms
quests.summary: Bring Starlight Vale to 50% restoration. The stars above it are starting to flicker awake.

quests.title: Whispers in the Roots
quests.summary: Elder Nova hears the land stirring. Meet her at the old tree stump at night.

quests.title: Voices in the Dirt
quests.summary: Find the first three journals of the Starlight Clan scattered across the Vale.

quests.title: The Lost Seed
quests.summary: A rare seed is hidden in the crystal cave. Orbit swears it isn't one of his rocks.

quests.title: Crystal Depths
quests.summary: The cave goes deeper than anyone thought. Light the way and map the lower gallery.

quests.title: The Meteor Mystery
quests.summary: Strange lights over the ridge. Investigate the crash site during the night.

quests.title: A Garden from the Sky
quests.summary: The meteor scorched a clearing. Pip dares you to make something grow in it.

quests.title: The Celestial Arboretum
quests.summary: Restore the arboretum and read what the Starlight Clan left behind.

quests.title: The Seed Vault
quests.summary: The arboretum hides a clan seed vault. Stock it with 3 different kinds of seeds.

quests.title: Pebble's Past
quests.summary: Deliver a sealed crate to Elder Nova. Don't shake it. Don't ask.

quests.title: Trade Routes
quests.summary: Fill Pebble's hold: sell him 10 crops of at least 3 different kinds.

quests.title: Star Charts
quests.summary: Pebble's charts burned in the crash years ago. Recover 3 fragments from around the Vale.

quests.title: Festival Preparation
quests.summary: Organize the first festival the Vale has seen in a generation.

quests.title: Lantern Light
quests.summary: String the market square with light: craft 10 festival lanterns from star honey and glass.

quests.title: The Midnight Visitor
quests.summary: Cosmo saw someone by the pond at midnight. Probably nothing. Definitely check.

quests.title: Valewide Bloom
quests.summary: Bring Starlight Vale to 75% restoration. The constellations overhead are half-lit now.

quests.title: Charts to Somewhere
quests.summary: The restored charts point to the first Sacred Garden. Unlock the Sun Garden.

quests.title: A Warm Welcome
quests.summary: Meet the keepers of the Sun Garden before the midday heat.

quests.title: Ember Harvest
quests.summary: Show the garden you can handle its heat: harvest 5 Solar Peppers.

quests.title: The Solar Forge
quests.summary: Relight the forge that once powered the garden's sun-tools.

quests.title: Desert Bloom
quests.summary: Bring the Sun Garden to 50% restoration and watch the dunes flower.

quests.title: The Moon Road
quests.summary: A silver path opens at dusk. Follow it and unlock the Moon Garden.

quests.title: Glow Harvest
quests.summary: The Moon Garden only reveals itself to night farmers. Harvest 5 Moon Melons.

quests.title: The Lunar Observatory
quests.summary: Restore the observatory so Noctua can chart the returning stars.

quests.title: Dreamtide
quests.summary: Bring the Moon Garden to 50% restoration. Dusk says the pond dreams again.

quests.title: The Star Road
quests.summary: Constellation light bends toward a hidden gate. Unlock the Star Garden.

quests.title: Constellation Farming
quests.summary: Grow 3 Constellation Starfruit — each one re-lights a star overhead.

quests.title: Stargazer's Rest
quests.summary: Rebuild the old observation deck where the clan once named the stars.

quests.title: The Sky, Relit
quests.summary: Bring the Star Garden to 50% restoration. Half the old constellations burn again.

quests.title: Into the Nebula
quests.summary: The final gate drifts among the floating islands. Unlock the Nebula Garden.

quests.title: The Sleeping Tree
quests.summary: Gather a sacred seed from each of the Four Gardens.

quests.title: The Heartseed
quests.summary: Host the Cosmic Festival and plant the Heartseed at the roots of the Great Cosmic Tree.

quests.title: A New Dawn
quests.summary: The Tree is awake. The galaxy is listening. Walk the Vale at sunrise.

quests.title: Infinite Fields
quests.summary: Every region, fully rewilded: reach 100% restoration in all five gardens.

quests.title: Master Gardener
quests.summary: Harvest 500 crops across your lifetime in the Vale.

quests.title: The Menagerie
quests.summary: A friend for every field: own 10 different animals at once.

quests.title: The Toolsmith's Pride
quests.summary: Collect every tool the gardens have to offer.

quests.title: Seed Baron
quests.summary: Sell 1000 crops through Pebble's trade routes.

quests.title: Perfect Soil
quests.summary: Thistle's impossible standard: 20 plots at 100 soil health simultaneously.

quests.title: Night Owl
quests.summary: Fifty harvests under the stars. Noctua is keeping count.

quests.title: Festival Circuit
quests.summary: Host a seasonal festival in all four Sacred Gardens.

quests.title: The Legacy Begins
quests.summary: The Vale will outlive us all. Unlock Legacy Mode and meet your successor.

quests.title: Challenge: Bare Hands
quests.summary: Cosmo's dare: harvest 20 crops on a fresh challenge farm with no tool upgrades.

quests.title: Comet Chaser
quests.summary: Witness 5 meteor showers. Orbit will trade stories for every one.

quests.title: Galactic Traders
quests.summary: Word has spread. Trade with 5 different alien visitors from beyond the Vale.

quests.title: The Complete Sky
quests.summary: Finish Vega's constellation chart: re-light all 12 constellations with Starfruit.

quests.title: Eternal Bloom
quests.summary: Complete every other quest. The galaxy remembers everything you planted.
